Visit the site before bidding and review all disciplines. Field verify dimensions, existing conditions, and equipment requirements.

Remove unused existing devices and associated wiring, conduit, and fittings. Coordinate demolition with architectural and mechanical work and obtain owner consent before de-energizing distribution panels.
Verify existing fire-alarm equipment functionality and provide an equipment-status report to engineer and owner.
Provide complete operational systems, including required junction/pull boxes not individually shown, permits, inspections, access panels, supports, and firestopping.

Default lighting, receptacle, and equipment branch circuits: 2 No. 12 plus 1 No. 12 ground unless otherwise specified. Provide an individual neutral for each circuit in multiple-circuit conduits. Copper conductors only.
Minimum raceway is 1/2-inch trade size; maximum unsupported flexible conduit length is 6 feet. Rust-proof one-hole straps required; tie-wrap supports prohibited.

Legend: ordinary and top-switched duplex/quad receptacles generally 18 inches AFF to center; GFCI duplex generally 42 inches AFF; telephone/data and TV outlets generally 18 inches AFF. Switch legend states 48 inches AFF to top.
Maintain redlined as-builts, provide updated panel directories and PDF O&M manuals, demonstrate operation, and provide at least one year parts-and-labor warranty.
Coordinate roof work to preserve roof warranty. Drawing note states: DO NOT SCALE OFF CONSTRUCTION DOCUMENTS.
